name: SVC_WO_TYPE_MAP
description: This table is used to store properties for work order types for each work order integration and are updated by admin users.  WO_TYPE_ID is the primary / unique key in this table.

columns.name: WO_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table

columns.name: WO_TYPE_LOOKUP_TYPE
columns.description: The work order type lookup type from FND_LOOKUP_VALUES.LOOKUP_TYPE to map to the integration application work order type code.

columns.name: WO_TYPE_LOOKUP_TYPE_CD
columns.description: The work order wo_type_cd is concatenated with wo_type_look_type. This is required by elastic search for enum sqlLookups.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: WO_TYPE_CD
columns.description: The work order type code from FND_LOOKUP_VALUES.LOOKUP_CODE to map to the integration application work order type code.

columns.name: FS_TYPE_CD
columns.description: The work order type code of the corresponding work order type code from the integrating application.

columns.name: WO_INTEGRATION_CD
columns.description: Work order integration code to represent the integration the type is associated with.

columns.name: DEFAULT_DURATION
columns.description: The default duration time in minutes it is expected to take in order to complete a work order of this type.

columns.name: SOURCE_CD
columns.description: Identifies the work order type code-owning application updated during the synchronization process. The work order type code can only be updated by the owning application.

columns.name: MULTI_DAY_FLAG
columns.description: Property used for a work order type code to identify that the work order will take multiple days to complete.

columns.name: ALLOW_RESCHEDULE_FLAG
columns.description: Property used for work order type code to identify that the work order can be rescheduled for another date.

columns.name: ALLOW_NON_SCHEDULED_FLAG
columns.description: Property used for a work order type code to identify that the work order can be created with only a resolution due.

columns.name: ENABLE_REMINDER_FLAG
columns.description: Property used for a work order type code to identify that the reminder time can be included on the work order.

columns.name: SUPP_INVENTORY_FLAG
columns.description: Property used for a work order type code to identify that inventory can be used on the work order.

columns.name: SUPP_REQ_INVENTORY_FLAG
columns.description: Property used for a work order type code to identify that required inventory can be used on this work order. The assigned field technician is then notified.

columns.name: SUPP_LINKS_FLAG
columns.description: Property used for a work order type code to identify whether the linking of predecessor and successor activity relationships is allowed on the work order.

columns.name: SUPP_PREF_RESOURCES_FLAG
columns.description: Property used for a work order type code to identify if resource preferences can be defined on the work order.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the work order type is logically deleted (Y or N).
